Python subclass identity/catching and TelegramObject behavior remain language-specific gaps.

ExternalReplyInfo, TextQuote, and ReplyParameters are native for typed nested models, source identities, UTF-16 entity extraction, numeric/string chat IDs, JSON/list conversion, and unknown-field retention. Message-originated reply event parsing, DEFAULT_NONE distinction for selected fields, Bot association, and shared TelegramObject behavior remain.

ReplyKeyboardMarkup is native for typed/string rows, string normalization, nested KeyboardButton values, optional flags, upstream keyboard-only equality, JSON/list conversion, extra fields, and button/row/column factories; arbitrary Python Sequence and mixed dynamic row coercion plus tuple immutability and TelegramObject behavior remain.

Native reply-keyboard removal value emits the required true flag, handles optional selective targeting, preserves unknown API fields, and supports JSON/list conversion; inherited TelegramObject behavior remains.

Native inline_message_id value, JSON conversion, API kwargs retention, equality/hash, and list conversion compile and pass focused checks; TelegramObject inheritance, freezing, and full upstream behavior remain.
SentWebAppMessage supports native Optional[String] values, missing/null JSON, equality/hash, API kwargs retention, and list conversion; TelegramObject behavior remains.

SharedUser, ChatShared, and UsersShared are native for source identity, optional names/usernames, nested PhotoSize lists, user/chat name and link helpers, JSON/list conversion, deprecated user_ids retention, and unknown fields; Python sequence/tuple behavior and TelegramObject semantics remain.

Story is native for nested Chat conversion, source equality identity (chat and story ID), API kwargs retention, JSON/list conversion, and hashing; the repost Bot shortcut, Bot association, and shared TelegramObject behavior remain.

LocationAddress, StoryAreaPosition, StoryArea, and all five StoryAreaType variants are represented as native Mojo data models, with float parsing/serialization, variant-specific equality, nested ReactionType/address conversion, list decoding, and future-field retention. Source-named subclass types are collapsed into StoryAreaType tagged values; TelegramObject behavior remains.
SuggestedPostPrice is native for string/integer JSON, equality/hash, API kwargs retention, and list conversion; remaining SuggestedPost classes are unported.
SwitchInlineQueryChosenChat is a native nullable string/Boolean model with source-derived equality and JSON conversion; TelegramObject behavior remains.

A native TelegramJsonDecodable/TelegramJsonObject trait defines static JSON decode/list and instance serialization contracts; shared bot association, immutability, repr, equality, pickle, deep-copy, and recursive serialization behavior remain.

All seven source classes are native: UniqueGiftColors, Model, Symbol, BackdropColors, Backdrop, UniqueGift, and UniqueGiftInfo. Nested stickers/chats/colors, identity/hash, JSON/list conversion, unknown fields, resale/transfer metadata, and UTC timestamp conversion are implemented. Bot-specific timezone defaults and TelegramObject behavior remain.

Native Update models all 25 Bot API update categories and matches the upstream positional constructor order. All 25 event payloads decode into typed native Mojo models, including business and chat-boost events. Equality/hash by update_id, JSON/list conversion, future-field retention, effective user/sender/chat/message accessors, and an ordered all_types() list factory are included. Shared TelegramObject behavior, cached property semantics, and exact Python union behavior remain open.

Native User covers all Bot API data fields through v22.8, stable ID identity, names, profile link, HTML and Markdown mentions, null/false JSON behavior, and unknown fields; the many Bot shortcut/network methods and mention_button remain unported.
Native UserProfileAudios preserves ordered nested Audio values, source equality fields, unknown JSON fields, and list conversion; tuple immutability and Bot shortcuts remain.
Native UserProfilePhotos preserves grouped PhotoSize rows, source equality fields, unknown JSON fields, and list conversion; tuple immutability and Bot shortcuts remain.
UserRating is a native integer/nullable integer model whose equality uses the upstream level/rating subset; JSON conversion is covered, while TelegramObject behavior remains.
Upstream package initializer is empty; native package re-exports its helper modules and compiles in imports.

Native helpers include LinkPreviewOptions resolution, homogeneous List sequence copying, and generic optional decode/list dispatch through the Mojo model trait; Python tuple return semantics, date/time coercion, decrypted helpers, and DefaultValue input unions remain.

Native Gregorian Date and normalized microsecond TimeDelta values plus fixed-offset POSIX TimestampDateTime conversion handle leap dates, pre-epoch values, offsets, and microseconds; named time zones, Bot defaults, environment-controlled timedelta migration/warnings, and zoneinfo lookup remain.
Native generic wrapper, sentinels, scalar get_value overloads, and explicit truthiness helper compile; wrapper identity, generic passthrough for arbitrary values, and Python str/repr behavior remain.

Native parse_message_entity accepts explicit UTF-16 ranges or a MessageEntity; parse_message_entities maps entity identity to text, defaults to upstream ALL_TYPES, and supports explicit type filters. Native List input replaces Python's arbitrary Sequence behavior, and Python dictionary details remain language-specific.

Native helpers classify string IDs, existing Path values, byte-list uploads, and InputFile values; local-mode file URIs are percent-encoded and upload results feed RequestParameter. Focused tests pass. Python IO stream objects, arbitrary TelegramObject pass-through/tg_type class dispatch, and Windows-specific file URI semantics remain open.

check_keyboard_type accepts native List[List[T]] rows, rejects nonempty List[String] inputs and String keyboards, rejects String-list buttons nested one level deep, and handles empty values. Arbitrary Python Sequence/tuple types, generic deeper-sequence detection, and distinguishing bytes from lists remain language-specific gaps.
Native selected-attribute repr construction preserves explicit field order and provides scalar stringification; dynamic Python object/class inspection and arbitrary keyword-value conversion remain.
TextEncoding and to_camel_case are native; CPython 3.11 Unicode mappings pass source-derived cases. Enum edge semantics still need review.
get_name, get_full_name, and get_link are native functions using Mojo Optional[String] and pass missing/empty-name checks.

The deprecation-message builder preserves upstream wording. A typed string-argument resolver mirrors truthiness, equality conflict errors, and carries a PTBDeprecationWarning value for old-name use; arbitrary Python values, callback invocation, warning filters, and stacklevel reporting remain unsupported.
Native version fields, formatting, tuple conversion, pre-release tags, and public constants are implemented; full named-tuple compatibility remains.

VideoChatStarted, VideoChatEnded, VideoChatParticipantsInvited, and VideoChatScheduled are native values with duration normalization, nested User lists, fixed-offset timestamps, JSON/list conversion, equality/hash, and future-field retention. Bot timezone defaults, Python deprecated integer-duration behavior, tuple semantics, and shared TelegramObject behavior remain.
WebAppData is native for string JSON, equality/hash, API kwargs retention, and list conversion; TelegramObject behavior remains.
Native URL value, JSON conversion, API kwargs retention, equality/hash, and list conversion compile and pass focused checks; TelegramObject inheritance, freezing, and full upstream behavior remain.

WebhookInfo is native for all upstream identity fields, nested timestamp values, optional metadata, allowed-update sequences, JSON/list conversion, validation, equality/hash, and future-field retention. Bot-specific timezone localization, immutable tuple behavior, Bot defaults, and shared TelegramObject behavior remain.
WriteAccessAllowed is a native nullable string/Boolean model with source-derived equality and JSON conversion; TelegramObject behavior remains.
Native values cover 95 enum types and globals; 620 source-derived member/value checks pass. Enum metaclass behavior and full docs remain.

Native TelegramError values normalize source prefixes and include named constructors, retry-after/chat-migration payloads, writable messages, and repr; distinct catchable subclasses, timedelta/environment migration behavior, deprecation warnings, and pickle compatibility remain.

Native extension package initializer exposes translated filters, partial BaseHandler behavior, MessageHandler Boolean-filter evaluation, statically specialized TypeHandler, and typed predicates for Poll, PollAnswer, PreCheckoutQuery, ShippingQuery, BusinessConnection, BusinessMessagesDeleted, PaidMediaPurchased, ManagedBotUpdated, ChatJoinRequest, ChatMember, ChatBoost, ChosenInlineResult, InlineQuery, Prefix, MessageReaction, CallbackQuery regex, and StringRegex updates, plus StringCommandHandler; callback/context/Application dispatch, remaining handlers, persistence, updater, rate-limiter, and job-queue exports remain pending.
Upstream package initializer is empty; the native package initializer is intentionally empty.

Native BaseHandler preserves DEFAULT_TRUE sentinel versus explicit bool, resolves the application block default, delegates typed update checks, and supports default or supplied context collection. Callback storage, asynchronous callback awaiting/result propagation, repr parity, and Application integration remain incomplete because Mojo 1.1 fails to compile generic async methods over arbitrary update/context types and raising async callbacks.

Native predicate matches BusinessConnection updates by typed user id or normalized username Set; typed absence and block-default behavior are covered. Python callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native predicate matches deleted-business-message updates by typed chat id or normalized username Set; typed absence and block-default behavior are covered. Python callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native predicate handles optional string regexes over callback data or game names, source XOR selection, empty values, and block defaults. PCRE2 syntax differs from Python re and patterns compile per check; callable/runtime-type patterns, Match results and CallbackContext.matches, callback invocation, and Application integration remain.

Native predicate matches chat_boost and removed_chat_boost updates, supports the upstream event-type constants, optional normalized chat-ID/username Set filters, and block-default resolution. Callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native predicate matches ChatJoinRequest updates by chat id or normalized requesting-user username Set; typed absence and block-default behavior are covered. Python callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native predicate matches typed chat_member and my_chat_member updates, supports the upstream event-type constants, optional chat-ID Set filtering, and block-default resolution. Callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native predicate matches chosen-inline-result Updates with an optional anchored PCRE2 regex over result_id and resolves block defaults. PCRE2 differs from Python re; typed Match results/context propagation, callback dispatch, and Application integration remain.

Native predicate checks the first BOT_COMMAND entity, command-name normalization/validation with Unicode decimal digits via PCRE2 UCP, optional bot-target username, Python-style whitespace arguments, bool or exact-count has_args rules, UpdateType.MESSAGES default filtering, and block defaults. The Message model has no associated Bot yet, so callers must set the bot username; callback/context/Application dispatch, filter data results, arbitrary Python Collection commands, PCRE2/Python Unicode database differences, and Match/context propagation remain.

Native predicate matches inline-query Updates with optional anchored PCRE2 regex over query, optional native List chat-type filtering, and block defaults. PCRE2 differs from Python re; typed Match results/context propagation, callback dispatch, and Application integration remain.

Native predicate matches ManagedBotUpdated when either the creator or bot user passes a typed id or normalized username Set filter. Typed absence and block-default behavior are covered; Python callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native MessageHandler stores a supplied BaseFilter or defaults to ALL, applies the filter to optional typed Updates, and preserves block configuration. Callback construction/dispatch, data-filter result merging into CallbackContext, and Application integration remain.

Native predicate covers reaction and reaction-count event selection, normalized chat/user identity Sets, the upstream restriction against user filters when anonymous events are included, and block defaults. Callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Python Collection inputs remain.

Native predicate matches PaidMediaPurchased updates by typed user id or normalized username Set; typed absence and block-default behavior are covered. Python callback/context/Application dispatch and arbitrary Collection constructor inputs remain.

Native PollAnswerHandler checks whether an optional typed Update contains a PollAnswer and carries BaseHandler block configuration. Callback construction/dispatch and Application integration remain pending.

Native PollHandler checks whether an optional typed Update contains a Poll and carries the BaseHandler block-default configuration. The callback constructor/await path and Application integration are pending; non-Update Python objects cannot be passed to the statically typed Mojo predicate.

Native PreCheckoutQueryHandler checks whether an optional typed Update contains a PreCheckoutQuery and carries BaseHandler block configuration. Callback construction/dispatch and Application integration remain pending.

Native PrefixHandler forms case-insensitive prefix-command combinations, parses arguments with Python-style Unicode whitespace splitting, applies UpdateType.MESSAGES or a supplied BaseFilter, and returns a tri-state result with arguments. Callback/context/Application dispatch and mixed scalar/collection constructor overloads remain.

Native ShippingQueryHandler checks whether an optional typed Update contains a ShippingQuery and carries BaseHandler block configuration. Callback construction/dispatch and Application integration remain pending.

Native StringCommandHandler matches slash-prefixed strings, preserves Python split-on-literal-space behavior including empty fields, returns argument lists, and resolves block defaults. Callback construction, context.args mutation, awaited callback results, and Application integration remain.

Native StringRegexHandler matches typed string updates with an anchored PCRE2 Unicode pattern and resolves block defaults. PCRE2 syntax/edge behavior differs from Python re and recompiles per check; Python Match captures, non-string object dispatch, callback/context/Application behavior remain.

Native TypeHandler is statically specialized by the handled Mojo type, matches present Optional values, and preserves strict/block settings. Dynamic Python type objects, subclass-aware isinstance behavior, callback/context dispatch, and Application integration remain.
The upstream initializer contains only license comments; the native initializer is intentionally empty.

Native update filters normalize scalar, optional, List, and Set inputs into deduplicated Mojo sets and strip one leading @ from usernames. Focused tests pass for scalar/List/Set values. Python frozenset immutability and arbitrary Collection inputs remain language-surface gaps; Optional values are currently overloaded for scalars and Lists, not Optional[Set].

Native typed TrackingDict uses List-backed key/value storage and unique dirty-key tracking for untracked reads, mapping-style indexing, keys/values/items snapshots, tracked writes/deletes, pop with omitted, typed, or None defaults, FIFO popitem, typed setdefault, clear, Dict-based tracked update and update_no_track, explicit mark, and drains of accessed keys or tagged write-items. List lookup is O(n); Python Mapping/UserDict polymorphism, arbitrary Mapping updates, live view objects, None-valued setdefault for non-Optional value types, and exact DELETED object identity remain unrepresented.

Native postfix filter values compose with AND, OR, XOR, and inversion. Implemented predicates cover common message/media/service types, all five chat types, supported message/business/guest update types, all 46 StatusUpdate predicates, all five Sticker filters, all seven fixed Dice emoji filters, and 21 unparameterized top-level metadata/service filters. Exact-match Text/Caption and SuccessfulPayment payload filters, PCRE2 Unicode Regex and CaptionRegex search predicates, Command start-position selection, Document category/file-extension/MIME-type filters, Entity/CaptionEntity type filters, scalar/list Language prefix filters, and Mention ID/username/typed-User matching are implemented. Dice value matching accepts native integer lists and scalars for generic and emoji-specific filters. Chat, User, ViaBot, SenderChat, and ForwardedFrom filters implement constructor-time ID/username matching, explicit allow-empty variants, and mutable add/remove/set operations; SenderChat all/channel/supergroup predicates are exposed as module constants. Native getters return List snapshots and setter functions replace assignable Python properties. Event fields absent from typed Message are evaluated from retained api_kwargs with Python-style truthiness; typed booleans, migration ids, lists, strings, models, and pinned_message preserve their truth semantics. Effective-message selection and the BaseFilter message-update gate are represented; UpdateType and other UpdateFilter expressions inspect Update fields after the same upstream gate. Focused smoke checks pass for scalar/list filter construction, username normalization, mutable ID/username updates, expression serialization, Dice value composition, and UTF-16 Mention entity slicing. Regex filter results remain Boolean, with no Match captures or CallbackContext.matches propagation. Runtime coverage of message predicates remains open. Remaining filter families, data-filter result merging, short-circuit semantics, and exact full nested Python namespace parity remain open.
Native escape_markdown, mention_html, mention_markdown, and create_deep_linked_url are implemented; effective_message_type and exact Python exception types remain.
Native request package exposes RequestData/RequestParameter preparation plus response parsing and error outcome helpers; async BaseRequest lifecycle and HTTPX transport remain unported.

Native response helpers decode successful JSON, extract POST results, and map common HTTP error responses into typed Telegram errors, including retry-after/chat migration parameters. A full BaseRequest value with async context management, retry/logging wrapper, timeout resolution, complete HTTPStatus phrases, and streaming/file retrieval behavior remains.

HTTPXRequest has a native synchronous transport using Mojo FFI to system libcurl, TLS peer/host verification, HTTP/1.1 or HTTP/2 mode, request timeouts, URL-encoded forms, multipart text and binary file fields, raw file retrieval, upstream user-agent, buffered response bytes, status extraction, error mapping, and lifecycle flags. Connection pooling, proxy/socket/httpx options, separate per-operation timeout overrides, async I/O, and cross-platform dynamic-library discovery remain.

RequestData collects parameters, creates raw and JSON parameter objects, UTF-8 payload bytes, form URL encoding, parametrized URLs, merged upload parts, and multipart form fields paired with in-memory uploads; encode_kwargs and arbitrary Python mappings/tuples remain.

RequestParameter stores typed JSON documents, encodes string/scalar values, and associates InputFile uploads plus InputSticker, InputProfilePhoto, and InputStoryContent attachments with attach URIs or parameter names; nested media conversion and general Python sequences/enums/datetimes remain.

PTBUserWarning, PTBRuntimeWarning, and PTBDeprecationWarning are native message values; deprecation formatting matches the upstream `Deprecated since version {version}: {message}` string. Mojo structs do not inherit Python Warning categories or participate in Python warning filters/stacklevel reporting.
